pages.text: Upgrade cards change the behavior of AE2 $(l:ae2_mechanics/devices)devices$(/l) and machines, increasing their speed, improving their filter capacity, enabling redstone control, etc.
Cards are crafted with either basic or advanced card bases
Redstone cards add redstone control, adding a toggle button in the device's GUI to swap between various redstone conditions.
Capacity cards increase the amount of filter slots in import, export, and storage busses, and formation planes.

Overflow destruction cards can be applied to $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_cells)storage cells$(/l) in a $(l:items_blocks_machines/cell_workbench)Cell Workbench$(/l) and will delete incoming items if the cell is full. (make sure to $(l:items_blocks_machines/cell_workbench)partition$(/l) your cells!) Combined with an equal distribution card, items will be voided if that specific item's section of the cell is full, even if other items' sections are empty.

Acceleration cards make stuff go faster, making import and export busses move more items per operation, and making inscribers and assemblers work faster.
Inverter cards swap filters in devices and tools from whitelist to blacklist.
Crafting cards let the device send crafting requests to your $(l:ae2_mechanics/autocrafting)autocrafting$(/l) system to get the items it desires.

Equal distribution cards can be applied to $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_cells)storage cells$(/l) in a $(l:items_blocks_machines/cell_workbench)Cell Workbench$(/l) and split the cell into equally-sized sections based on what the card is $(l:items_blocks_machines/cell_workbench)partitioned$(/l) to. This prevents one item type from completely filling the cell.
Energy cards add more energy storage to certain tools like portable terminals, and make $(l:items_blocks_machines/vibration_chamber)Vibration Chamber$(/l)s more efficient.
